title: Cycle count on the Inactive tab counts only the inactive parts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with quantity 5.
  • Inventory parts {Part-B} and {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-02 and -03) are inactive and tracked, with quantity 5 each.
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Cycle count.
  6. Click the printer icon in the count toolbar and look at the count sheet in the print preview.
  7. Close the print preview without printing.
  8. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
  9. Click the Active tab.
  10. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  11. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  12. Click Cycle count.
  13. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The actions menu on the Inactive tab offers Cycle count.
  • Step 5: The count starts on the Inactive tab: {Part-B} and {Part-C} are listed, each with an empty Count box, and {Part-A} is not listed.
  • Step 6: The count sheet lists {Part-B} and {Part-C} and does not list {Part-A}.
  • Step 8: The count ends without saving, and the quantities are unchanged.
  • Step 12: On the Active tab the count lists {Part-A} with a Count box, and does not list {Part-B} or {Part-C}.
  • Step 13: The count ends without saving.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S1-R10, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.7 (Cycle count leaves it out), 13 Oct copy.
